entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How 'bout that!? It don't matter if you're[n]some god or whatever! In your face!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like you couldn't control us[n]after all, huh?

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: ...You would never have had to suffer[n]had you merely died in ignorance.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: How conceited you must be to think[n]man and god would be equal in power...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's unpersuasive given you're on the[n]verge of destruction.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's hurry up and bust that thing up[n]before it goes into another one of them[n]annoyin' speeches!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Just accept your fate! We're gonna[n]crush you!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hmph. I suppose I should commit this[n]ominous image to memory before it is[n]gone forever...
